reviewScope: Full public source review of harness, preload, CMake and output contract; exact V2 closure of the preserved frozen V1 directory refusal. No implementation execution.

preservedStaticStop.finding: V1 observed() refused OUTPUT descendant directories. Current CLI creates and fsyncs sealed replicas under OUTPUT before NEXT retention, so this refused before the first barrier.
preservedStaticStop.closure: V2 changes exactly one predicate/comment: pass every directory except exact OUTPUT root. All live pre/post/final sealed-replica directories remain noneligible. Test, CMake and CONTRACT are byte-identical to V1.

substantiveChecks: Fresh CLI exec, only PATH and explicit test preload variables, bounded atomic event/control packets tied to case/index/PID and same FD device/inode metadata.

Actual WIFSTOPPED SIGSTOP before inspections; actual SIGKILL and waitpid join before suffix modification or original-copy reopen. Terminal child reaped at wait_stopped clears owned PID before refusal.
Barrier database readers use fresh SealedReadonlyReplica trees only. RocksDB readers and replica capabilities close before every SIGCONT. No live RW owner is opened RO.
Both original planned NEXT files retain their roles/request/current bindings; the apply and both typed recover children fsync both exact new NEXT files and output directory before operational Pair.
Independent WITNESS NEXT canonical intent and full cold/fragment blob closures must authenticate before PRIMARY observation is armed.

SDK VectorLogPtr/GetSortedWalFiles, live type, normalized relative PathName and LogNumber classify only a positive observed append candidate. File transfer bytes and live FD/path device/inode are tied. No guessed filename, largest-log selection or SizeFileBytes truncation offset.

Append before/return pairs are recorded; only SDK-classified WAL must have a positive contiguous append-at-physical-EOF chain. Recycled, overwrite, rotation or unobserved WAL refuses. Non-WAL writes and empty candidates do not qualify a barrier.

A retains bytes and accepts measured previous or NEXT PRIMARY; B truncates only the observed suffix after joined kill and requires previous PRIMARY; C requires real backend sync return zero and NEXT PRIMARY. All require exact WITNESS NEXT.

Generic and wrong-NEXT recovery refuse without protocol-row changes; two genuine typed CLI recoveries use the original two NEXT files; final archive/index, raw snapshot, unrelated rows, cold closure, execution coupling and repeat idempotence are checked.
CMake adds only the two Linux test selectors and Threads::Threads for the test-only shim; it adds no production hook, installable shim, core/header ABI, policy or quota change.
